scope: Primary player implementation; semantic inspection only,no code copied into fvid.
observations: patternLoop stores a per-channel start marker on E60; E6n initializes or decrements the per-channel repeat counter and requests a jump while it is nonzero.
Loop starts and counters are initialized for playback,not reset at every order transition. Multiple channels retain independent counters.
getNextPos applies pattern-loop row changes before position jumps. All flow commands share pBreakPos; later channel commands determine the final resume row.
FT2 explicitly retains the last loop break row until order transition,which can start the next pattern at that row. It resets an out-of-range actual destination row to0.
Finite local row loops are distinct from the existing native one-pass global order-entry policy. The implementation will retain the latter and apply row budgets to every expanded row.
